lines.text: Wait for me, not wait me!
Many learners say: I am waiting you here.
Better: I am waiting for you here.
The second! I am waiting for the bus.

data.right: I am waiting for you here.
data.memory: I am waiting for you here.

native.tip: Türkçede “seni bekliyorum” deriz; İngilizcede “wait” fiilinden sonra “for” gerekir.
native.caption: “I am waiting you here” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “wait” fiilinden sonra “for” gelir. Doğrusu “I am waiting for you here.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “for the bus”. “Wait” sonrası “for” gelir. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: After “wait” you need “for”: “I am waiting for you here.”
en.caption: Do you say “I am waiting you here”? 😅 In English “wait” needs “for” before the person or thing. The right sentence is “I am waiting for you here.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
